rules.statement: In a hire-purchase agreement, the defence of non est factum is usually taken in conjunction with fraud or duress and may be based on mistake, such as misapprehension regarding the nature and substance of the transaction.
rules.supporting_quote: "the defence of non est factum, that the contents of the memorandum of agreement were not read and explained to the hirer, is usually taken in conjunction with the plea that the hirer was induced to sign a document by fraud or duress. Alternatively, the defence may be based on mistake, namely misapprehension as to the nature and substance of the transaction."
